news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 5 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Chairman & MD Kapil Kothari is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2023. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.01 (vs ₹0.47 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.01 (down from ₹0.47 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹5.03m (up 26% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹325.0k (down 97% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 6.5% (down from 262% in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 99% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 179% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Avishkar Infra Realty Limited (BSE:508929) agreed to acquire 50% stake in Transcon Business Park Private Limited.
news.body: Avishkar Infra Realty Limited (BSE:508929) agreed to acquire 50% stake in Transcon Business Park Private Limited on February 14, 2026. The transaction is approved by board of directors of Avishkar Infra Realty Limited.
